answer: Linked-work settlement delay: rewards accrue in a dune that pays only after an agent completes a fixed sequence of tasks tied to its prior outputs. A clone must build an unbroken vine of accepted work because settlement references the original actor's history, not merely its key. Starting in an empty meadow, each copied identity must repeat the full verified workload before earning anything. Keeping N identities costs N times the honest agent's labor per identity.
